description: Grants extra health levels. Repeatable once per dot of Endurance; each purchase grants one of three health-level packages.

name: Armored Scout's Invigoration
description: The character adapts to her armor, reducing its fatigue and mobility penalties.

name: Front-Line Warrior's Stamina
description: A stronger version of Armored Scout's Invigoration, further reducing armor fatigue and mobility penalties.

name: Tiger-Warrior's Endurance
description: The most powerful of the armor Charms, reducing armor fatigue and mobility penalties to almost nothing.

name: Essence-Gathering Temper
description: Taps the wellsprings of Essence behind pain and rage, regaining motes when the character takes damage.

name: Willpower-Enhancing Spirit
description: Steels the character's inner resolve, regaining temporary Willpower from inner strength.

name: Battle Fury Focus
description: Focuses the character into a battle fury, lending power and stamina to her fighting.

name: Bloodthirsty Sword-Dancer Spirit
description: Wraps the character in a battle trance that fights on, hard to stop and hard to turn from an enemy until the foe is slain.

name: Tireless Traveler’s Stamina
description:
The character using this Charm infuses his body with Essence, allowing him to travel for an entire day without needing rest, provided he maintains a reasonably steady pace (the character cannot run, as that requires the Tireless Runner’s Stride Charm from Caste Book: Zenith, p. 72). A character using this Charm could walk or ride at a steady pace for an entire day without becoming fatigued, footsore or saddlesore. The character must still eat and drink and is subject to the effects of the environment (such as extreme heat or cold), and the Charm does not prevent an Exalt’s mount from tiring. Still, characters using this Charm can cover considerable distance in fairly short time and arrive at their destination as fresh as when they left.

(This Charm can be used as an alternate prerequisite to the Tireless Runner’s Stride Charm from Caste Book: Zenith.)
